title: Length of time with August and Cyune
summary: Played about six years with August until he left for Chicago in 1922 or 23, then long with Cyune.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: You got August with you first. You were with him. How long were you with August? Well, August and I, we played around together. I'd say around about six years, around here. Then finally August left, went Chicago.
